name: Himukai Chihiro
source:
A friend who I've been estranged with since we graduated from highschool. Cheerful, positive, outgoing, attractive -- she's the type to be popular with both men and women. 

A hardhead by nature, she's the type of person to take pride in her work and equally the people who endure it with her. Her nature compels to speak out against injustice and the nonsensical even if it rubs others the wrong way. As you can imagine, that nature doesn't lead her to her popularity in her professional life and gives her no shortage of headaches of not being able to compromise and hold down a job. 

In highschool, I was the only one she could talk to frankly without holding back her thoughts whatsoever.

"Flattery won't get you anywhere. I can see through it all."
